(b) In such event, the court may impose such

(2) Where the issues upon which the trial of
the action is to proceed have been settled by
the Judge conducting the Pre-Trial hearing, no
amendment thereto shall be made at the trial,
save  in  special  circumstances  and  unless  the
court is satisfied that a refusal to permit such
amendment would result in manifest injustice
to the party applying for the amendment.
(3) Where issues both of law and facts arise
in  the  same  action,  and  the  court  is  of  the
opinion  that  the  case  may  be  disposed  of  on
the issues of law only, it shall try those issues
first, and for that purpose may, if it thinks fit,
postpone  the  settlement  of  the  issues  of  fact
until  after  the  issues  of  law  have  been
determined.”.
